title: dream rollerskaters - assemble here
content: I have covid right now and I'm trying not to think about how I fucked up my sister's b-day and got my boyfriend sick. Let's talk about something I have been seeing on this sub's comments instead. How many of YOU guys are skaters? Rollerskates, rollerblades, hell even skateboarders, snowboarders, skiiers, avid scooter users. Personally, I've been skateboarding since 10, and rollerskating like a MADMAN since the pandemic, halfpipes and grinds and all. The mallworld has been present since 2017-18. The skating shows up in my dreams really often, specifically, rollerskates. Flying around in my dreams is not new, but the roller mechanic or actual skates has been going on for about two years now. It's fucking awesome. I love it when I end up at the venice beach-ey boardwalk, or my old high school. I want YOU to comment here if you have ever rolled around in a dream :)
